parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, s.code AS service, si.code AS site, c.debut, c.fin, c.capacite, c.places_reservees,
       (c.capacite - c.places_reservees) AS places_disponibles
FROM creneaux c
JOIN services s ON s.id=c.service_id
JOIN sites si ON si.id=c.site_id
WHERE s.code='{{$json.service}}'
  AND si.code='{{$json.site}}'
  AND c.statut='DISPONIBLE'
  AND c.places_reservees < c.capacite
  AND c.debut >= ('{{$json.dateDebut}}'::date)
  AND c.debut <  ('{{$json.dateFin}}'::date + interval '1 day')
ORDER BY c.debut;
